title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
title_zh: 我们能否停止回测？面向自适应金融研究智能体的任意时有效晋升检验

paragraphs.en: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce Promote , a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel–rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for Promote ; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, Promote has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 金融研究智能体生成和监控交易规则的速度，快于人类记录由此产生的筛选过程的速度。 候选规则在依赖数据的时间点出现，弱规则被放弃，而有希望的规则则被持续观察，直至跨过报告阈值。 我们提出 Promote，一种为每个候选规则在诞生时分配可预测的检验财富、并仅从后续收益累积成本感知 e 过程的协议。 若生命周期分配之和至多为一，加权 Ville 论证可界定「宣告的有界净得分条件均值始终非正」的规则被晋升的概率。 该结果允许候选规则相互依赖、适应性诞生以及无限期监控。 我们在两种场景下审计该实现。 一项回顾性伪样本外回放包含 24 个面板-规则假设、3,000 条共享符号的零假设路径、注入的备择假设，以及公开的 ETF 与行业数据。 未经多重检验校正的重复检验在 94.5% 的零假设路径中产生族群跨越，而 Promote 为 0.0%；在 15 个基点的对齐 ETF 成分扰动下，Promote 具有 70.1% 的目标功效，跨越会话中位数为 2,327。 一项独立的精确均值为零的实验允许智能体从过去得分中选择候选身份与诞生时间；在 3,000 个程序中，资助门槛的假族群跨越率为 1.77%。 扣除成本后，市场回放中未产生任何晋升。 该证书控制的是在宣告的零假设下的历史假晋升；它并非证明先前的优势在部署时仍然盈利的证书。

paragraphs.en: A conventional backtest has a nominal end date. Research rarely does. An analyst looks at interim results, changes the universe, adds a seasonal interaction, drops an unpromising rule, and continues when the evidence is close. An autonomous research agent can perform the same sequence at machine speed. Treating the final rule as if it came from one fixed test understates the number of opportunities the system had to be lucky.
paragraphs.zh: 传统回测有一个名义上的结束日期，而研究工作往往没有。 分析师会查看中期结果、更改选股范围、加入一个季节性交互项、舍弃一条没有前景的规则，然后在证据尚不充分时继续研究。 自主研究智能体可以以机器速度执行同样的流程。 把最终规则当作来自某一次固定检验的结果来对待，会低估系统有多少次碰运气的机会。

paragraphs.en: This failure is familiar in empirical finance. Data-snooping corrections compare many strategies on a common terminal sample ( White, 2000 ; Hansen, 2005 ; Romano and Wolf, 2005 ) , while empirical-finance protocols quantify selection and backtest overfitting ( Harvey et al., 2016 ; Bailey et al., 2017 ; Arnott et al., 2019 ) . Neither device, by itself, authorizes continuous inspection of a library whose membership is decided from the observed history. The relevant error event is operational: did the research process ever promote a strategy whose declared net score has no positive conditional mean?
paragraphs.zh: 这种失败在实证金融中并不陌生。 数据窥探校正在一个共同的终端样本上比较多种策略（White, 2000; Hansen, 2005; Romano and Wolf, 2005），而实证金融协议则量化选择偏差与回测过拟合（Harvey et al., 2016; Bailey et al., 2017; Arnott et al., 2019）。 这两种工具本身都无法对一个其成员资格由观测历史所决定的策略库授权进行持续检视。 相关的错误事件是操作层面的：研究过程是否曾经推广过一个其宣称的净得分不具有正的条件均值的策略？

paragraphs.en: Test martingales and e-values are well suited to this question because they remain valid at stopping times ( Ville, 1939 ; Shafer et al., 2011 ; Vovk and Wang, 2021 ; Ramdas et al., 2023 ) . Their use still requires a protocol. A newly proposed rule must not inherit evidence from before it was specified; adding near-duplicates must consume a finite research budget; transaction costs must be known before the return used to update the test; and trading must begin after, rather than on, the boundary-crossing observation. Those details are where an apparently safe backtest can leak.
paragraphs.zh: 检验鞅（test martingales）与 e 值非常适合这个问题，因为它们在停时（stopping time）处仍然保持有效性（Ville, 1939；Shafer et al., 2011；Vovk and Wang, 2021；Ramdas et al., 2023）。 它们的使用仍然需要一个协议。 新提出的规则不得继承其被指定之前的证据；添加近似重复项必须消耗有限的研究预算；交易成本必须在用于更新检验的收益之前已知；并且交易必须在边界穿越观测之后开始，而不是在该观测之上进行。 这些细节正是看似安全的回测可能发生泄露之处。

paragraphs.en: In the ledger, “hash the rule” means compute a cryptographic fingerprint of one canonical, machine-readable package containing the executable code and all settings that determine its trades. For example, the package includes the asset universe, signal formula, parameter values, data fields, calendar, position sizing, rebalance timing, and cost convention. A function such as SHA-256 maps those bytes to a short identifier: identical packages produce the same identifier, while even a small edit almost certainly produces a different one. The hash is not the rule, encryption, or proof that the rule is correct; the full package is retained. It is a tamper-evident label that lets an auditor verify exactly which frozen version was registered before later returns arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 在账本中，“对规则做哈希”是指对包含可执行代码及决定其交易的全部设置的单一规范化的机器可读程序包，计算其加密指纹。 例如，该程序包包含资产范围、信号公式、参数值、数据字段、交易日历、头寸规模确定方法、再平衡时点以及成本核算约定。 像 SHA-256 这样的函数会将这些字节映射为一个简短的标识符：完全相同的程序包会产生相同的标识符，而哪怕极小的改动也几乎必然产生不同的标识符。 哈希本身不是规则，不是加密，也不是规则正确的证明；完整程序包仍被保留。 它是一个可防篡改的标签，让审计人员能够准确核验在后续收益产生之前注册的究竟是哪一个冻结版本。

paragraphs.en: Conditioning is what permits adaptive research: pre-birth observations may determine the rule’s code, identity, and mass, but cannot enter its post-birth product. Abandonment can set future bets to zero but does not replenish the account; the program already enjoyed a crossing opportunity. paragraphs.zh: 条件化（conditioning）正是允许适应性研究的关键：诞生前的观察可以决定该规则的代码、身份与质量，但无法进入其诞生后的产物。 放弃（abandonment）可以将未来的投注归零，但不会补充账户；该程序已经享受过一次跨越机会。 复活、重新缩放或邻近的参数化需要另一次扣款。 质量为零的候选者不具备资格。 这些规则阻止了免费重启和隐藏的近似重复测试。

paragraphs.en: The implementation crosses three asset panels with eight calendar definitions, giving 24 panel–rule hypotheses. This is the fixed-family special case of Theorem 2 : within the replay, all candidates are frozen before the 2015 segment is processed and receive equal wealth. Adaptive births and data-dependent allocations are not exercised by the market replay; Section 4.3 isolates them under an exact mean-zero score law. The panels are six equity ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, and VNQ), five defensive or diversifying ETFs (IEF, TLT, GLD, DBC, and SHY), and the ten value-weighted Fama–French industries. The rules are turn of month, first three and last three trading days, Monday, Friday, last three trading days of a quarter, January, and the third Friday of a month. The common daily sample runs from March 2006 through May 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现将三个资产面板与八种日历定义进行交叉，得到24个面板–规则假设。 这是定理2的固定族特例：在回放中，所有候选智能体在处理2015年区间之前均已冻结，并获得相等的财富。 市场回放并未行使适应性诞生和数据依赖的分配；第4.3节在精确的均值得分律下将它们单独隔离。 这些面板是六只股票ETF（SPY、QQQ、IWM、EFA、EEM和VNQ）、五只防御性或分散化ETF（IEF、TLT、GLD、DBC和SHY），以及十个市值加权的Fama–French行业。 这些规则是月初、前三个和后三个交易日、周一、周五、季度的最后三个交易日、一月，以及某个月的第三个星期五。 共同的日度样本从2006年3月持续到2026年5月。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 exposes the full operating curve rather than a single favorable effect. The valid procedures detect none of the zero- or 5-bp target paths; with 1,500 paths, the zero-count Wilson upper endpoint is 0.26%. The repeated z workflow, by comparison, declares the target on 23.2% of zero-shift paths and 74.2% of 5-bp paths, so its apparent sensitivity cannot be separated from its inflated inspection error. Between 10 and 15 bp the funded methods move through their steep transition. The anytime rule gains 2.0 and 2.9 power points over the terminal rule, respectively, because it retains paths that cross earlier and later fall below 480; overlapping intervals caution against interpreting these differences as a tuned advantage. At 20 bp the power gap nearly disappears, but the anytime median crossing is 1,125 sessions earlier than the terminal decision. Even at 30 bp, its median requires 1,049 sessions. The boundary therefore rewards persistent net evidence, not a visually strong but short backtest.
paragraphs.zh: 表2展示的是完整的运行曲线，而非单一的有利效应。 有效程序在零碱基或5碱基对的目标路径上均未检出任何信号；在1,500条路径下，零计数的Wilson上限为0.26%。 相比之下，重复z检验流程在零位移路径上判定达到目标的比例为23.2%，在5碱基对路径上为74.2%，因此其表面上的灵敏度无法与其虚高的检验错误区分开来。 在10至15碱基对之间，获得资金支持的方法正处于其陡峭的过渡区间。 随时规则相比终止规则分别获得2.0和2.9个百分点的功效提升，因为它保留了那些较早穿越边界但随后跌破480的路径；区间相互重叠提醒我们不要把这些差异解读为经过调优的优势。 在20碱基对处，功效差距几乎消失，但随时规则的中位穿越时间比终止决策早1,125个交易日。 即使在30碱基对处，其中位数仍需要1,049个交易日。 因此，该边界奖励的是持续的整体净证据，而非视觉上强劲却短暂的回测。

paragraphs.en: The estimated FWER stays below 5% for every policy, but the finite-sample rates illustrate a design trade-off rather than a ranking theorem. Spending half of the remainder gives early proposals the lowest boundary, then rapidly shrinks later masses; it also has the largest crossing rate here. Equal slots retain more capacity for late births and spend only 82.36% on average because programs register fewer than 12 candidates. The signal-dependent and quarter-remaining rules happen to produce the same 53 crossing programs, but their masses are not generally identical. Allocation may favor proposals using information available at birth; it must not be revised after observing their test evidence. This separates an auditable research priority from post-selection threshold shopping.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种策略，估计的族错误率（FWER）都保持在 5% 以下，但有限样本速率说明的是一种设计上的权衡，而非一个排序定理。 花费剩余部分的一半会给早期提议最低的边界，随后迅速缩减后期的配额；它在这里也有最高的越界率。 等额划分为晚期出现的情形保留了更多容量，且平均只花费 82.36%，因为项目注册的候选数量少于 12 个。 信号依赖规则和四分之一剩余规则恰好产生了相同的 53 个越界项目，但两者的配额一般并不相同。 配额分配可以利用提议诞生时已可获得的信息来偏向某些提议；但在观察到其检验证据之后，绝不能再进行修改。 这就把可审计的研究优先级与选后阈值挑拣区分了开来。

paragraphs.en: The rowwise replay verifies three deterministic invariants: the 24 fixed-family weights sum to one, every test e-process restarts at one, and no promoted return is credited before the interval following a crossing. The adaptive simulation checks variable birth times, identities, masses, and family sizes under an exact mean-zero law. Seeds 20260731 and 20262731, the complete hypothesis ledger, summary tables for 15,000 simulated programs or paths, and SHA-256 hashes of every machine-readable result accompany the artifact.

paragraphs.en: Backtest overfitting has been studied through data-snooping tests, superior-predictive-ability tests, multiple-testing adjustments, and selection diagnostics ( White, 2000 ; Hansen, 2005 ; Romano and Wolf, 2005 ; Harvey et al., 2016 ; Bailey et al., 2017 ) . These methods address closely related selection problems, usually for a collection evaluated at a terminal sample size. Our target is the event generated by an ongoing research system: a false strategy is promoted at some random time after a data-dependent proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 回测过拟合已通过数据窥探检验、优越预测能力检验、多重检验校正以及选择诊断方法得到研究（ White, 2000 ; Hansen, 2005 ; Romano and Wolf, 2005 ; Harvey et al., 2016 ; Bailey et al., 2017 ）。 这些方法处理的是密切相关的选择问题，通常针对在终止样本量下评估的一组对象。 我们的目标是由持续运行的研究系统所产生的事件：一个错误策略在数据依赖型提议之后的某个随机时刻被提拔。

paragraphs.en: Online multiple-testing methods allocate error across a sequence of hypotheses, including alpha-investing and adaptive FDR rules ( Foster and Stine, 2008 ; Javanmard and Montanari, 2018 ; Ramdas et al., 2018 ) . Our pathwise masses are deliberately simpler: they are a weighted online Bonferroni allocation for familywise control, with no claim of wealth recycling. That conservative choice makes the audit rule transparent when candidate identities and birth times are selected from the past.

paragraphs.en: E-values provide the underlying evidence currency ( Vovk and Wang, 2021 ) , and safe testing, betting-based inference, and confidence sequences explain their optional-stopping behavior ( Grünwald et al., 2024 ; Waudby-Smith and Ramdas, 2024 ; Howard et al., 2021 ; Ramdas et al., 2023 ) . The e-BH procedure extends the framework to false-discovery control under arbitrary dependence ( Wang and Ramdas, 2022 ) . Sequential e-values have also been used to evaluate probability forecasts and backtest financial risk measures ( Henzi and Ziegel, 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) ; those applications test forecasts, whereas our unit is a strategy-promotion workflow. We use the conservative wealth-weighted crossing rule because one false launch can matter operationally. Our contribution is its implementation as a strategy-level gate, an exact adaptive-birth audit, and a reproducible market ledger with costs and delayed deployment.

paragraphs.en: Calendar and technical trading rules provide a demanding case study because their design space is easy to expand and many reported effects are sample-sensitive ( Lakonishok and Smidt, 1988 ; Sullivan et al., 1999 ; Sullivan et al., 2001 ; Bajgrowicz and Scaillet, 2012 ) . More broadly, the attenuation of published return predictability and the prevalence of false anomaly rejections motivate a strict separation between discovery and deployment ( McLean and Pontiff, 2016 ; Chordia et al., 2020 ) . The candidate generator may instead be a language model, feature search, or a human, provided its executable definition and wealth are fixed before scoring. ICAIF studies multiscale evaluation of financial time-series foundation models ( Cheong et al., 2025 ) , and AAAI studies trading-policy generalization beyond offline data ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Neither controls the probability of ever promoting a null strategy during adaptive search.
paragraphs.zh: 日历效应与技术交易规则提供了一个严苛的案例研究，因为其设计空间易于扩展，且许多已报告的效应对样本敏感（Lakonishok and Smidt, 1988; Sullivan et al., 1999; Sullivan et al., 2001; Bajgrowicz and Scaillet, 2012）。 更广泛地说，已发表收益可预测性的衰减以及虚假异象拒绝的普遍存在，促使人们严格区分发现阶段与部署阶段（McLean and Pontiff, 2016; Chordia et al., 2020）。 候选生成器也可以是语言模型、特征搜索或人类，只要其可执行定义和资金（wealth）在评分之前被固定。 ICAIF 研究金融时间序列基础模型的多尺度评估（Cheong et al., 2025），AAAI 研究超越离线数据的交易策略泛化（Yuan et al., 2026）。 两者都无法控制在自适应搜索过程中提升零策略（null strategy）的概率。

sents.en: For example, q e = 6 / [ π 2 ​ ( e + 1 ) 2 ] q_{e}=6/[\pi^{2}(e+1)^{2}] reserves finite lifetime wealth while making the threshold grow quadratically rather than permitting cost-free restarts.
sents.zh: 例如，取 q e = 6 / [ π 2 ( e + 1 ) 2 ] q_{e}=6/[\pi^{2}(e+1)^{2}] 可在保留有限生命周期财富的同时，使阈值按二次增长，而不是允许无代价的重启。

sents.en: Epoching does not prove that a profitable regime persists after crossing; it makes every renewed authorization depend on fresh post-restart observations and a declared share of the lifetime error budget.
sents.zh: 纪元化并不能证明越过阈值后盈利状态仍会持续；它使每一次重新获得授权都依赖于重启后的新鲜观测以及声明的生命周期错误预算份额。

paragraphs.en: The guarantee is narrow by design. It concerns the clipped, cost-adjusted score and a null that is uniformly nonpositive after birth; it does not certify that a formerly positive edge remains profitable. Clipping can also suppress rare economic losses. It occurs in 128 of 68,832 historical candidate–session scores (0.186%), so every evidence row is retained beside its unclipped return.
paragraphs.zh: 该保证在设计上是狭窄的。 它针对的是截断后的、经成本调整的分数，以及出生后一致非正的零假设；它并不证明一条曾经为正的边仍然保持盈利。 截断还可能掩盖罕见的经济损失。 它发生在 68,832 个历史候选–会话分数中的 128 个（0.186%），因此每一条证据行都与其未截断的收益一并保留。

paragraphs.en: The two simulations answer different questions. Shared independent signs preserve magnitudes and contemporaneous cross-rule dependence, but remove serial sign dependence and freeze observed cost fractions; the resulting null is generally strict. The adaptive audit is exactly mean zero and exercises selection and staggered births, but its iid Rademacher scores are not a market model. Neither construction asserts that realized returns satisfy ( 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这两种模拟回答的是不同的问题。 共享的独立符号保留了幅度与跨规则的同期相依性，但去除了序列符号相依性并冻结了观测到的成本比例；由此得到的原假设通常更为严格。 自适应审计恰好具有零均值，并考察了选择与错期出生，但其独立同分布的 Rademacher 得分并不是一个市场模型。 两种构造都没有断言已实现的收益满足 ( 2 )。

paragraphs.en: Validity is only as trustworthy as the filtration. Revised data, survivorship-biased universes, pretrained-model knowledge of the replay era, or same-close execution can import future information. A production agent must therefore retain data and prompt hashes, candidate births, allocations, and rejected proposals. An idea without a deterministic executable rule receives no testing wealth.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性的可信程度取决于过滤的质量。 修订过的数据、幸存者偏差的样本池、预训练模型对回放时期的了解，或以同一收盘价执行，都可能引入未来信息。 因此，生产环境的智能体必须保留数据与提示词哈希、候选策略的诞生记录、资金分配以及被否决的提案。 没有确定性可执行规则的想法不会获得测试资金。

sents.zh: 有效性的可信程度取决于过滤的质量。

paragraphs.en: The economic replay uses adjusted closes and zero cash yield. Five-basis-point turnover costs are explicit, but financing, borrow fees, bid–ask dynamics, impact, taxes, and capacity are absent; French industries are not directly tradable. The design and pseudo-out-of-sample periods were chosen retrospectively, and realized trading-day ranks can encode rare unscheduled closures. These facts make Table 5 an audit, not a live performance claim.
paragraphs.zh: 经济回放使用调整后收盘价，且现金收益率为零。 已明确计入五个基点的换手成本，但不包括融资、借券费、买卖价差动态、冲击、税收与容量；且法国行业不可直接交易。 设计期与伪样本外期为事后选定，且实际交易日排名可能包含罕见的计划外休市。 这些事实使表 5 成为一项审计，而非实盘业绩主张。

paragraphs.en: Finally, familywise control becomes conservative when an agent proposes many correlated variants. Hierarchical predictable allocations expose but do not eliminate that cost; discovery-oriented systems may prefer FDR control. In all cases, promotion should trigger a separately governed forward evaluation rather than unrestricted scaling.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，当一个智能体提出许多相关变体时，族错误率控制会变得过于保守。 分层可预测的分配虽然暴露了但不消除这一代价；以发现为导向的系统可能更倾向于采用 FDR 控制。 在所有情况下，晋升都应触发一项单独治理的前向评估，而不是不受限制的扩展。

paragraphs.en: In production, a crossing is an authorization request, not an order. A pre-trade gate still checks data availability, venue and borrow eligibility, spread and impact, concentration, turnover, and duplicate portfolio exposure. It may veto or cap a trade without changing the evidence. A predictable risk kill switch may stop exposure or betting, but cannot reclaim testing mass or justify a same-day restart.
paragraphs.zh: 在生产环境中，越界（crossing）是一项授权请求，而不是指令。 交易前闸门仍会检查数据可用性、交易场所与借券资格、价差与冲击、集中度、换手率，以及重复的组合敞口。 它可以否决或限制一笔交易，而不会改变证据本身。 可预测的风险熔断机制可以停止敞口或投注，但无法回收测试样本量，也不能为当日重启提供正当理由。

paragraphs.en: The ledger should fail closed: missing prices, ambiguous calendars, stale features, or a code-hash mismatch suspend updates and deployment until an operator records the resolution and first usable session. The e-process asks whether the historical null was crossed; operations controls ask whether the position is safe to trade now.
paragraphs.zh: 账本应当默认失败即暂停：缺失价格、模糊日历、过期特征或代码哈希不匹配时，应暂停更新与部署，直到运维人员记录解决方案和首个可用会话。 e-过程询问历史零假设是否被突破；运营控制则询问当前持仓是否可以安全交易。

paragraphs.en: A certificate moves through registered, accumulating, crossed, authorized, suspended, and expired states. Crossing concerns one frozen version; authorization is separate and time limited. Expiry requires a funded epoch from Section 6.1 ; corrected history cannot backdate promotion.
paragraphs.zh: 证书会经历已注册、累积中、已冻结、已授权、已暂停和已过期等状态。 冻结只针对某一个冻结版本；授权是独立的，且有时限。 过期需要第 6.1 节所述的已注资周期；更正后的历史不能追溯提升。

paragraphs.en: The release manifest binds the fingerprint to its rule package, data vintage, calendar, costs, bet grid, budget, and expiry. This supports audits of replay, post-decision inputs, and the first trade. It does not prove profitability; it prevents implementation changes from voiding the theorem’s premises.
paragraphs.zh: 发布清单将指纹与其规则包、数据版本、日历、成本、下注网格、预算和有效期绑定在一起。 这支持对回放、决策后输入以及首笔交易的审计。 它并不能证明盈利能力；它防止实现层面的变更使定理的前提失效。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive research changes the unit of inference. The relevant object is the sequence of proposals, inspections, and stopping decisions, not one terminal backtest. Promote gives that process a finite error budget: candidates inherit no evidence and must cross a cost-aware, wealth-adjusted boundary. The guarantee survives continuous monitoring and an adaptively expanding library.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应研究改变了推断的单位。 相关对象是提案、审查与停止决策所构成的序列，而非单次最终回测。 Promote 为该过程提供了一个有限的错误预算：候选智能体不继承任何证据，必须跨越一个成本感知、经财富调整的边界。 该保证在持续监控和自适应扩展的策略库下依然成立。

paragraphs.en: The experiments expose the price: repeated inspection finds winners readily, whereas the valid gate may wait for weak effects. That delay is the cost of an optional-stopping guarantee, not evidence of current profitability. Frictions, scale, and forward risk remain deployment questions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验揭示了代价：反复检验可以轻易找到赢家，而有效的门槛则可能要等待微弱的效应。 这种延迟是可选停止保证的成本，而不是当前具有盈利能力的证据。 摩擦、规模和前瞻风险仍然是部署阶段需要解决的问题。
